summary: Titra is a self-hosted time-tracking application designed for freelancers and small teams. It helps users log hours and monitor time spent on various tasks and projects within a central web interface.
goodFor: Freelancers and small team administrators who need a dedicated, self-hosted utility specifically for logging time rather than a heavier enterprise project management suite.
watchOut: The project exhibits slowing development activity, which might mean slower bug fixes or a lack of new features over time.
deployNotes: As a JavaScript application packaged for containerisation, it typically requires a persistent volume for data storage and a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
